name: Nanbu Riho
source:
Protagonist's blood-related sister who is the model of a "Big Sister." When they were kids, she filled in the gaps in their mother's absence, so she's good at cooking.

[Adapted from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/ichaane/character111.html]official website[/url]]
